provenance.input_rule: input index i is active at step t iff (i*31 + t*17) % 23 == 0
provenance.mask_hex_encoding: little-endian bits within each byte: channel i -> byte i/8, bit i%8; 256 bytes = 512 hex chars over 2048 channels
provenance.per_step_fired_ids_encoding: per_step_fired_ids[t] is the ascending list of hidden-neuron IDs that fired at step t, for all 512 steps; it is the exhaustive fired-ID oracle and is consistent with per_step_spike_count and selected_raster_rows
provenance.selected_step_rule: every 64th step (0,64,...,448) plus the final step 511
provenance.topology_encoding: topology_edge_order[n] is a flat array [src0,wbits0,src1,wbits1,...] of fan_in (source, weight_bits) pairs in Corinth edge order (NOT sorted); weight_bits are f32 to_bits()
